title: Employee and Dependent Eligibility Provisions, Employer Group Contracts
content:
**Section 1. Employees.** Under an Employer Group Contract in the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series, an employee is eligible when regularly working at least the segment's minimum hours per week and after completing the employer's new-hire waiting period; coverage starts the first of the month after the waiting period. The new-hire waiting period is the one the employer chose for its contract from the waiting periods the segment schedule offers.

**Section 2. Entry.** An employee who enrolls within the timely enrollment window of first becoming eligible, at open enrollment (which runs during the open enrollment window before renewal) or by special enrollment enters normally; others enter as late entrants when the segment's late-entrant rules apply.

**Section 3. Dependents and retirees.** Domestic partners may be enrolled when the segment allows domestic partners, and retirees may stay enrolled only when the segment allows retiree coverage.

## How an employee enters

| How the employee enrolls | Entry |
|---|---|
| Within the timely enrollment window of first becoming eligible | normal entry |
| At open enrollment | normal entry |
| By special enrollment | normal entry |
| At any other time, in a segment where late-entrant rules apply | late entrant |

An addition is recorded with its entry reason (open enrollment, new hire, special enrollment or late entrant), the coverage tier elected (member only, member and spouse, member and children, or family), the hire or qualifying event date, the coverage start date and the date the employer reported it.

## Coverage start (hypothetical hire dates)

For an employee who meets the hours standard and is hired on March 10:

| Employer's waiting period | Waiting period completed | Coverage starts |
|---|---|---|
| 0 days | on hire | April 1 |
| 30 days | in early April | May 1 |
| 60 days | in early May | June 1 |
| 90 days | in early June | July 1 |

## Retirees

Retirees may stay enrolled only in a segment that allows retiree coverage; in a segment that does not allow it, retirees do not stay enrolled.
